title: Bulk Handling Equipment - Bag Stacker-Cum-Loader/Unloader - Portable - Design and Construction - General Requirements
clause_1_scope: This standard covers general requirements for design, manufacture and testing of portable bag stacker-cum-loader/unloader (PBSCLU) suitable for stacking/destacking bags of nominal mass of 100 kg and below with provision of luffmg and propelling

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
